protocol.role: Exploratory mechanism audit of a completed development screen; not fresh confirmation or promotion evidence.
protocol.bootstrap_unit: One seed, carrying both seats, both opponent matchups, and all candidate/incumbent paired outcomes together.
protocol.independence_limitation: COK and Seyam share replay-route ancestry. Seed intervals do not quantify opponent coverage or repeated candidate-selection uncertainty.

seyam.lineage: Kaito Fukami public V18/C20 routes with recovery overlay
seyam.license: Apache-2.0 attributed portions; notices retained in clone

cok.lineage: Adaptive Farming Strategy public routes with recovery controller
cok.license: Apache-2.0 attributed portions; notices retained in clone

environment.seed_note: The interpreter removes seed from configuration and retains the resolved seed in episode info; every resolved_seed matches the declared seed.

action_parity.method: Frozen raw-source official loader; recorded observation only; no simulator step or future state read by callable.

audit.method: Read saved states, replay only recorded unit actions and market orders on independent copies using official helpers, check resulting cash against next saved state; no daily refresh, new randomness, counterfactual game, or policy tuning.
audit.historical_harness_diff: Baseline to screen changes add source/bundle metadata, loader checking, and overwrite protection; episode execution and Telemetry are unchanged.
audit.opponent_sales_method: Both players' transactions are reconstructed in the same official market pass.

reference-cok.qualification: Accounting identity, not a controlled causal decomposition; later shops and other production can respond to the intervention.

current_frontier.conclusion: Historical-pool challenger only: no demonstrated improvement against the current Mooman reference; both policies lose every inspected game.
